verdict.rationale: AgentMail inboxes are API objects within an organization, so anyone holding a key sees the same threads, and Labels can track conversation state. Standard IMAP/SMTP clients can also connect to the same inbox, which makes shared viewing plausible. However, nothing in the evidence documents team-oriented shared-inbox features; scoped keys and pods are framed around agent and tenant isolation rather than human team collaboration. Missing for 10: explicit shared-inbox or team-member access model, assignment and collision handling, team channels, documented synchronized read/state across teammates, independent corroboration.
